module: Detects player speeding on the road sections of a rally loop. Every second, the player vehicle's speed is sampled into a circular buffer of 5 values; if the average exceeds the limit, a penalty is drawn at random with a probability proportional to the excess. Penalties are spaced at least 60 s apart and passed to the manager via recordSpeedingPenalty.
usage:
local det = require('gameplay_rally_loop_speedingDetector')(manager)
-- every frame:
det:update(dtSim, 70, false)
notes: Normal mode: probability = min(excess / 60 * 0.05, 0.05), i.e. 5% at most at 60 km/h over. Strict mode: min(excess / 5 * 0.2, 0.2), i.e. 20% at most at 5 km/h over.
The draw uses math.random() on the average of the last 5 seconds, not the instantaneous speed.
The test starts with the penalty delay already elapsed (timeSinceLastPenalty = 60), so the first penalty is possible immediately.
drawDebug (not called: the call is commented out in update) shows, in strict mode, a probability based on the instantaneous speed, which differs from the actual computation in update (average).
The module returns a constructor: require('gameplay_rally_loop_speedingDetector')(manager). Speeds in km/h (vehicle speed in m/s * 3.6).

C.desc: Speed detector. Instance fields: manager, currentLimitKph, bufferSize (5), data (circular buffer), writeIndex, count, sampleRate (1 s), penaltyRateLimit (60 s), penalties (list of triggered penalties), maxSpeedOver/maxProbability (60 / 0.05), strictMaxSpeedOver/strictMaxProbability (5 / 0.2), strictMode.

init.desc: Initializes the buffer and parameters. Called by the constructor.

getCurrentSpeedKph.desc: Speed of player vehicle 0 in km/h (speed norm * 3.6).

returns.desc: km/h, nil if there is no player vehicle.

addSample.desc: Adds a speed to the circular buffer, overwriting the oldest if needed.

getAverageSpeed.desc: Average of the valid samples in the buffer.

stochasticPenalty.desc: Randomly decides whether a penalty is triggered based on the average relative to the limit: linear probability from 0 (at the limit) to maxProbability (at maxSpeedOver above).

maxSpeedOver.desc: Excess (km/h) to reach the maximum probability.

returns.desc: true if the penalty is triggered.

update.desc: Call every frame. Accumulates time, takes a sample every second and, if the 60 s delay has elapsed, draws a penalty; on a penalty, stores {averageSpeed, instantSpeed, speedLimit, speedOver, probability, strictMode} and calls manager:recordSpeedingPenalty.

limitKph.desc: Speed limit in km/h (nil = no limit, never a penalty).

strictMode.desc: true to use the strict parameters.

drawDebug.desc: ImGui window "Speeding Detector Debug": limit, current and average speeds, probability, penalties and samples. Currently never called by update.
